title: [master] Description Field value gets automatically reverted the original value after changing it.
summary: Fixed a bug where the Description field on sales lines would revert to its original item value after editing, when Calc. Inv. Discount was enabled and Quantity had been validated.
key_points: Editing Description after validating Quantity reverted it when Calc. Inv. Discount was enabled
In CalculateSalesSubPageTotals the NeedRefreshSalesLine reset sat after the TotalsUpToDate early exit, so the flag stayed true
The reset now runs before the early exit, so RefreshSalesLine no longer reloads the line and drops the edit
Applied to the W1, BE and NA Document Totals codeunits
Test added in the Document Totals pages test codeunit
quote: Description Field value gets automatically reverted the original value after changing it.
